The people are fickle. No mask can[XENO:n ]
hide that girl's contaminated blood.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Consort of Light, all the pieces are in place.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Say the word and the captive Homs shall be no more.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]The savage who discovers fire remains a savage.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]Disappointed or not, His Highness[XENO:n ]
will turn a blind eye to their fate.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

And their removal will deprive Melia[XENO:n ]
of some powerful allies.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

We continue to endure the contamination of our[XENO:n ]
bloodline by perpetuating this wretched tradition of[XENO:n ]
a High Entia Consort of Light and Homs Consort of Shadow.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
For how long must I suffer these Homs?![XENO:wait wait=key ]
Do your duty, Talco.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
